summary.zh-Hans: 御窑博物馆的建筑由八个大小不一的拱券结构组成，设计灵感来自景德镇传统窑炉。博物馆位于陶阳里御窑景区。
summary.en: The Imperial Kiln Museum has eight vaults of varying sizes, inspired by traditional Jingdezhen kilns. It is part of the Taoyangli Imperial Kiln scenic area.

names.zh-Hans: 景德镇中国陶瓷博物馆

summary.zh-Hans: 景德镇中国陶瓷博物馆是一座陶瓷专题博物馆，前身为景德镇陶瓷馆。馆藏涵盖多个历史时期，展示景德镇制瓷历史中的代表性品种。
summary.en: This ceramics museum grew out of the former Jingdezhen Ceramics Museum. Its collection spans many periods and includes representative wares from Jingdezhen’s history of porcelain production.

summary.zh-Hans: 景德镇冷粉使用较粗的圆米粉，煮好后拌入调料。配料可有辣椒、香葱和橘子皮等。
summary.en: Jingdezhen lengfen uses thick, round rice noodles tossed with seasonings after cooking. Additions can include chili, scallions and tangerine peel.

summary.zh-Hans: 饺子粑是外形似饺子的景德镇米制小吃，用米粉皮包入熟制馅料，通常蒸熟。常见馅料有韭菜豆干、萝卜丝虾米等。
summary.en: Jiaoziba are Jingdezhen snacks shaped like dumplings, with rice-flour wrappers and cooked fillings, usually steamed. Fillings include chives with dried tofu or shredded radish with dried shrimp.
